messages:
anna.finance: Heads up 1: procurement shortlisted ReconcilePro and InvoiceWeave for invoice/usage reconciliation. Key asks: per-request line items, cost-center tagging, NDJSON/Parquet export to GCS, and clear credit/refund policy.

derek.sourcing: Nice. Do we have sample NDA + sample export formats? We should confirm timezone normalization (UTC vs vendor local) and currency conversion for EU customers.

anna.finance: ReconcilePro sent an NDJSON sample and a Parquet schema. InvoiceWeave sent CSVs only. ReconcilePro includes a charge_type field (api, storage, credit). InvoiceWeave aggregates by day only.

jordan.eng: if InvoiceWeave aggregates daily that's probably a blocker. We need request-level join keys: request_id, session_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_usd, cost_local, cost_center_tag. Can InvoiceWeave do per-request export via API?

anna.finance: InvoiceWeave says per-request is "coming Q2" but can provide event webhooks with a 24h delay. ReconcilePro supports streaming webhooks + bulk exports.

marta.legal: We also need to check their DPA, data deletion SLA, and if they allow customer-managed keys for exports. InvoiceWeave's DPA mentions EU processing but not region pinning. That's a red flag for some customers.

sophia.billing: Pricing snapshot: ReconcilePro = $0.018/1k tokens + $1,000/mo platform + free onboarding. InvoiceWeave = $5k/mo commit up to 200M tokens, overage $0.02/1k, onboarding $2k. InvoiceWeave offers invoice-level credits for disputes within 45 days.

anna.finance: Can we ask ReconcilePro to add team-level cost_center_tag in the invoice export? That is a hard requirement for our chargeback.

derek.sourcing: I'll push for waived onboarding fee from InvoiceWeave and a 60-day trial cap of 50M tokens. For ReconcilePro I'll try to get platform fee waived with a 12mo commit.

jordan.eng: technical checklist for vetting vendors:
- realtime webhook (>= 99.9% uptime) and replay for 7 days
- export formats: NDJSON, Parquet, CSV
- BigQuery/native connectors or GCS for Parquet
- consistent timestamps in ISO8601 UTC
- model_name and request_id guarantee
- SSO + SCIM for roles
- audit logs for invoice changes
- ability to attach custom tags (cost_center, project_id)
If any vendor fails >2 items, escalate.

sophia.billing: For billing ops we need daily line items, CSV/Parquet partitioned by date, and cost_center mapping. Also need a monthly reconciliation report summarizing credits/disputes.

marta.legal: Add termination clause: 30-day data retrieval window plus certified deletion. Also require SOC2 Type II report and breach notification within 72 hours.

procurement-bot: Ticket created: PR-2026-0610 1 (Vendor reconciliation evaluation). Assigned to @derek.sourcing. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-2026-0610

anna.finance: Action items:
- Derek: negotiate onboarding fee waiver + pilot cap with InvoiceWeave (due Thu)
- Derek: request region pinning + CMK option from InvoiceWeave (due Thu)
- Jordan: validate ReconcilePro Parquet schema + webhook replay (due Wed)
- Sophia: build cost model comparison (12mo, 24mo) incl commit/overage scenarios (due Tue)
- Marta: request SOC2 + sample DPA redlines from both vendors (due Fri)
Please update PR-2026-0610 when done.

derek.sourcing: noted. Also asking both for a sample dispute workflow (how they handle credits/prorations). InvoiceWeave already documented one: submit ticket -> 15 business days resolution window -> credit applied if validated. ReconcilePro promises automated dispute detection and credits within 7 days.

jordan.eng: one more ask: can vendors include per-model cost split when a request fans out to multiple models (e.g., embedding + rerank + gen)? ReconcilePro confirmed yes with breakdown fields. InvoiceWeave unclear.

sophia.billing: Approval thresholds: finance can greenlight pilots up to $12k without FP&A. Above that needs head of finance signoff. We should structure pilot as engineering trial to stay under $12k if possible.

anna.finance: Agree. Also check GL code = FIN-SW-SaaS. Need W9 or local tax form for non-US vendors.

marta.legal: For non-US vendors also require standard indemnity language and export compliance confirmation.

derek.sourcing: Suggest we offer ReconcilePro a 12mo preferred vendor agreement in exchange for platform fee waiver and a documented SLA for exports.

anna.finance: ok. I'll draft the vendor comparsion doc in the ticket and include sample exports.

procurement-bot: Reminder: PR-2026-0610 will trigger Legal review step if selected vendor requests enterprise contract.

sophia.billing: final Q for the thread: anyone comfortable with a pre-approved pilot cap of $12k for this work?

anna.finance: I can approve $12k for pilot under manager signoff.

derek.sourcing: good, proceeding. end of thread."
